query:
UPDATE steering.steerers s
                    SET display_name    = $2,
                        description     = $3,
                        enabled         = $4,
                        authority_id    = a.id,
                        default_mode_id = m.id,
                        model           = $7,
                        priority        = $8,
                        config          = s.config || $9::jsonb,
                        prompt          = $10,
                        trigger_point   = $11,
                        invocation      = $12,
                        pattern         = $13,
                        project_id      = $14,
                        updated_at      = NOW()
                   FROM steering.authorities a,
                        steering.modes       m
                  WHERE a.code = $5
                    AND m.code = $6
                    AND s.id   = $1
